description: A made-up scenario: planning a surprise party for a friend both sides know different things about.
title: Plan Sam's birthday party
event: a surprise birthday party for Sam, a friend of you both
opening_line: Hi! I'm so glad we're planning Sam's surprise party together. We need to pick a place, an activity, and a gift. Do you have any ideas?
settle_example: So, a scarf for the gift?
closing_line: That's the whole party planned, then. Thanks for planning this with me, Sam is going to love it!

participant.brief: You and your friend are throwing a surprise birthday party for Sam, a friend of you both. Plan it together.

constraints.text: Your home is too small for a party.
Sam doesn't like loud, crowded places.
You can't spend much on the gift.

avatar.brief: You are planning a surprise birthday party for Sam together with the user. The user is a friend of yours, and Sam is a friend of you both.

constraints.text: Your home is being painted this week.
Sam has a sore knee, so nothing too active.
Sam already has more books than shelf space.
